title: Allowance for a Storage Account Kept Clear
content:
A member who keeps the account clear earns the prompt-settlement allowance on the charges being cleared under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements. The allowance is a rate on those charges, and it is taken off the total drawn into the settlement.

## What the schedule provides

Where no charge stands past its grace period and a storage settlement has cleared on the account within the last six months, the full prompt-settlement rate of 1.5 percent is allowed.

Where no charge stands past its grace period, or a storage settlement has cleared on the account within the last six months, the modest rate of 0.5 percent is allowed.

And otherwise no allowance is given.

The allowance is worked out on the charges drawn into the settlement and on nothing else, and is rounded to the nearest cent before it is taken off.

## The combinations in full

| No charge stands past its grace period | A storage settlement cleared on the account within the last six months | Rate allowed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | 1.5 percent |
| yes | no | 0.5 percent |
| no | yes | 0.5 percent |
| no | no | none |

The full rate wants both limbs together; either limb alone carries the modest rate; neither limb carries nothing.

## Worked allowances, on hypothetical figures

**Charges drawn into the settlement of 862.40, nothing standing past its grace period, and a settlement cleared on the account three months ago.** Both limbs stand, so the full rate of 1.5 percent is allowed: 862.40 multiplied by one and a half percent is 12.936, which rounded to the nearest cent is 12.94, and that is taken off the total.

**The same 862.40 with nothing past grace but no settlement cleared in the last six months.** One limb stands, so the modest rate of 0.5 percent is allowed: 4.312, which rounded to the nearest cent is 4.31.

**Charges of 862.40 with a charge standing past its grace period and no settlement cleared in the last six months.** Neither limb stands, and no allowance is given.

## Questions the desk meets

**What is the rate worked out on?** The charges drawn into the settlement, and nothing else. Anything collected alongside the settlement is not part of the figure the rate is worked on.

**When is it rounded?** To the nearest cent, before it is taken off.
